title: Taking STEPS Forward: Enhancing Online Peer-Counseling with Schema Therapy via Socratic Questioning

live_model.evidence: "We used the \"gpt-4o-2024-05-13\" model in experiments but based on initial comparisons, expect the results to apply to all LLMs" (footnote 8, Sec. 3)

prompt.location: Appendix C (Socratic-question generation prompts); Appendix D (system interface)
prompt.note: Two LLMs role-play the conversation: STEPS as peer counselor, LLM_Patient as support seeker, seeded from 20 CounselChat forum posts.

claim.metric: Assessment / Cognitive scores (0-6 scale) for LLM_ST+phases vs. STEPS, rated by human judges
claim.location: Sec. 3 Experiments ("collecting human ratings on a scale from 0 to 6")

data.source: CounselChat forum posts (Bertagnolli, 2020), 20 posts used, via a prior Schema-Therapy study (Gollapalli et al., 2023)

notes: Otherwise a strong candidate (role S/B, gpt-4o-2024-05-13 explicitly dated, full prompts in Appendix C, public CounselChat data, small n=20), but the headline Assessment/Cognitive metrics are human ratings collected by the authors' own raters (0-6 scale), not an automatically reproducible number -- reproducing the exact reported values would require re-running new human evaluation, hence human_outcome.
